title: infiniband: don't call the data dissector if reassembly should be retried
description:
This is much better fix compared to commit
c462f1f4d2ee67cce30d73ea411ae6172f534a58
("infiniband/smbdirect: fix dissecting the first smbdirect negotiate request")
    
Here's a sample capture
https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark-web/-/issues/62
https://gitlab.com/-/project/22852016/uploads/538c095d29f38f95b5231fd7b9e05bdf/rdma2-rxe-r6.18-tmp-10.pcap.gz
This is a Windows server 2025 as server with an Intel-E810-CQDA2 card in
roce v2 mode (10.123.102.5) and smbclient kernel smbdirect using
software roce rdma_rxe (10.123.102.4) This uses smb signing so there's
no rdma offload for the write.
    
This fixes dissecting of frame 6, while reassembling still works
at the infiniband layer, e.g. frames 50 + 51, as well
as the smbdirect layer, see how frame 51 is part of frame 2388.
    
Assisted-by: Claude
Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

This reverts commit c462f1f4d2ee67cce30d73ea411ae6172f534a58.
